summary.text: Dorothy Hitchmoth is the Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Merrimack 7, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She advanced from the Republican primary on September 8, 2026, and ran for the same seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Hitchmoth and Claire Ann Ketteler advanced from the Republican primary for Merrimack 7 on September 10, 2024.
Incumbent Karen Ebel and Gregory Sargent defeated them in the general election.
